rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to roof shingles on back porch overhang; approximately four shingles blown off with no water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Note: damage is below the $2,500 deductible, so claim is not payable.

case_facts.description: approximately four shingles blown off by wind; no water intrusion or secondary damage
